question: After the first three ordered classes are validly closed, can the final private counter/tag/transform class supply exactly one finite, source-compatible twelve-field Dusk-only fight-local contract without reopening an immutable family or adding a prohibited selector?
hypothesis: The complete fight-local carrier partition contains no legal contract: aggregate, player, enemy and card-owned private state alias closed causal topologies, while an explicit card transform requires the prohibited hand-card selector.
claimBoundary: Exact-source carrier completeness, immutable-closure aliasing and zero-row legality only. No support, capacity, causal endpoint, policy control, complementarity, package, detector, product, protected-seed, #421 acceptance or P9 claim.

scientificBasis.serialEntry: The complete terminal class, exact cross-turn representation and intent-history class have reached their immutable automatic dispositions. Owner comment 5460811702 orders private counter/tag/transform last.
scientificBasis.carrierCompleteness: A fight-local mediator that spans producer and consumer must be owned by aggregate/player combat state, one enemy, one card instance or a card-instance mutation. Rule-owned side tables are aggregate equivalents; locals cannot span; event queues cannot own gameplay truth; persistent carriers are excluded.
scientificBasis.noGuessing: A carrier is not a complete mechanism. No source or immutable evidence selects a new event, threshold, named pair, payoff or automatic card selector after the mapped causal topologies close.
scientificBasis.methodBoundary: There is no legal candidate domain or measured policy-repertoire bottleneck, so enumeration has stopped at the finite representation partition and no QMC, optimiser, RL or quality-diversity run has decision value.
